workflow.name: hello_pi
workflow.rules: Write concisely. The poem must be 3 lines or fewer.

step.task: Write a short poem about {topic} and save it to the file output/poem.txt. Return only the relative path of the saved file as your final response.

Read the file {poem_path}, count its lines, and write ONLY that integer (no other text, no trailing prose) to the relative path output/line_count.txt under the current directory. Return only the relative path of the file you wrote as your final response.

if.ask: Does the file {count_path} contain an integer of 1 or greater?
Does the content of file {poem_path} read as a poem?

step.role: You are a careful file clerk. You write exactly what is requested — nothing more, nothing less — and you never editorialize.
step.task: Write exactly APPROVED to the relative path ./output/note.txt under the current directory (do not convert it to an absolute path). Return only the file path as your final response.
